caption: The drawing features two illustrations of the same dress, positioned side by side on a plain light background. On the left is a simple outline sketch of the dress, showing its back view with clear horizontal divisions for layered ruffles and a fitted bodice, but with no color or intricate detail. On the right is a completed colored version of the dress shown from the front, featuring a checkered pattern in shades of blue and cream. The dress has a fitted bodice, a collared neckline with a white lace collar, buttons down the front, elbow-length puffed sleeves with two horizontal ruffles, and a full skirt composed of five wide, horizontal ruffled tiers. Green accents appear along the edges of each ruffled layer. The fabric's checkered pattern is consistent throughout the dress, and the ruffles add volume at both the sleeves and skirt. The two illustrations are placed on a plain, unadorned background without any additional objects or elements.
title: Afternoon Dress
